# prepare_animation

Nguồn: [manim.animation.animation.prepare_animation](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.animation.animation.html#manim.animation.animation.prepare_animation)

prepare\_animation(*anim*)
:   Returns either an unchanged animation, or the animation built
    from a passed animation factory.

    Examples

    ```
    >>> from manim import Square, FadeIn
    >>> s = Square()
    >>> prepare_animation(FadeIn(s))
    FadeIn(Square)
    ```

    ```
    >>> prepare_animation(s.animate.scale(2).rotate(42))
    _MethodAnimation(Square)
    ```

    ```
    >>> prepare_animation(42)
    Traceback (most recent call last):
    ...
    TypeError: Object 42 cannot be converted to an animation
    ```

    Parameters:
    :   **anim** ([*Animation*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.animation.animation.Animation.html#manim.animation.animation.Animation "manim.animation.animation.Animation") *|* *\_AnimationBuilder* *|* *\_AnimationBuilder*)

    Return type:
    :   [*Animation*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.animation.animation.Animation.html#manim.animation.animation.Animation "manim.animation.animation.Animation")
